City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation for Men's Health Month.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 10/7/15 Special Meeting and the 10/14/15 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-10-28 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-10-28 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Third amendment to the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System San Diego Regional Stormwater Copermittees Memorandum of Understanding. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Resolution 2015-73, approving the Third Amendment to the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System San Diego Regional Stormwater Copermittees Memorandum of Understanding, and authorizing the City Manager to execute the agreement.
2015-10-28 Item 8C - NPDES SD Regional Stormwater Copermittees MOU Amendment
8D.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2015-05, which proposes changes to the City's density bonus ordinance to implement California density bonus law. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Zoning Ordinance and Local Coastal Program. Project #14-202 POD. Contact Person: Special Counsel Kautz
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-05 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Chapter 30.16.020.C [Density Bonuses Pursuant to Government Code Section 65915] of the Encinitas Municipal Code" as reflected in Attachment A.
2015-10-28 Item 8D - Density Bonus Ordinance 2015-05 Adoption
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2014-15. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Approve and adopt the actual ending fund balances for FY2014-15 as beginning fund balances for FY2015-16 (Attachment 1, Column 9); 2) Approve the revised Schedule A, Revised Budget Summary FY2015-16, presented in Attachment 4; and, 3) Approve Resolution 2015-72 authorizing a lump sum payment to CalPERS to reduce the City of Encinitas unfunded pension liability in the amount of $341,956 which is 5% of the FY2014-15 budget surplus of $6,839,114 (Attachment 5).
2015-10-28 Item 10A - Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2014-15
10B.
Public hearing and Adoption of Resolution 2015-63 Regarding Findings Related to the Unexpended Fund Balance for Impact/Mitigation fees collected prior to 6/30/10 and acceptance of the Annual Report of Development Impact/Mitigation Fees for fiscal year ended June 30, 2015 as required by the California Mitigation Fee Act. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Adopt Resolution 2015-63 Regarding Findings Related to the Unexpended Fund Balance for fees collected prior to 6/30/10 and accept the Annual Report of Development Impact/Mitigation Fees for fiscal year ended June 30, 2015.
2015-10-28 Item 10B - Mitigation Impact Fee Findings and Report
10C.
Amend City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management and Administrative Policy G009 Integrated Pest Management Plan. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent La Riva
Amend City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management to eliminate the use of products or materials that contain glyphosate(s).
2015-10-28 Item 10C - Integrated Pest Mngmnt Policy Amendment
10D.
Status report regarding public safety and downtown issues during the summer. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst McSeveney
Receive the report and provide staff direction as needed.
2015-10-28 Item 10D - Downtown Safety
10E.
Montgomery Avenue At-Grade Pedestrian Rail Crossing. Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
1) Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract with HDR Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $521,650 plus 10% contingencies to develop plans, specifications, construction documents, environmental clearance, and California Public Utilities Commission approval for the construction of an At-Grade Pedestrian Rail Crossing at Montgomery Avenue, for a not to exceed total project allocation of $573,766; and, 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-77, authorizing the appropriation of general funds in the amount of $573,766 to the Montgomery Avenue At-Grade Pedestrian Rail Crossing Project (CS16E).
2015-10-28 Item 10E - Montgomery Rail Crossing
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - None
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - None
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-10-28 Item 15 - City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
The November 11, 2015 Regular City Council meeting has been canceled in honor of Veterans Day. The next Regular City Council meeting will be held on November 18, 2015.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
